justification: Assessment returned INVALID and pinned the same pivotal inference as the ground truth: the implicit lemma that 3-colourability of the interior arrangement graph G-bar plus 3-colourability of the boundary cycle dG implies 3-colourability of G, ignoring the cross edges. Its witness is a different-but-valid instance of the same refutation: triangle a1a2a3 (chi=3, playing G-bar), 4-cycle b1b2b3b4 (chi=2<=3, playing dG), plus cross edges b1a1,b1a2,b1a3. I verified concretely that {a1,a2,a3,b1} induces K4 (all six edges present), so chi>=4, and the exhibited 4-colouring a1=1,a2=2,a3=3,b1=4,b2=1,b3=2,b4=1 is proper (b2:4,2; b3:1,1; b4:2,4), so chi=4 exactly; both parts are 3-colourable and the graph is planar as described. Same defect as ground truth readings A/B'.
